text:
Devin: quick sync — planning to onboard solace-8b (quant-lite) and pin v1.2 to the catalog alias `solace-stable` tonight around 22:00 PST. Who can own the deploy + rollback?
Sarah: I can own the canary and smoke checks. :raised_hands: 22:00 PST works for me.
Marco: I can be on rollback standby — will be around 21:45–23:30. What's the canary % and smoke checklist?
Devin: thanks. Canary 5% for first 30m, then 20% for next 30m if green. Smoke checklist: 1) end-to-end latency P50 < 120ms on staging replica, 2) unit cost jump < 10%, 3) prompt regression run (our standard 120 prompts), 4) KV cache warmup < 2s for common prefixes.
Olivia: tagging the catalog-bot for the pin command and registry entry. Also FYI: dedicated-only customers should keep using solace-8b:v1.1 until we push a dedicated-compatible quant patch next week.
catalog-bot: reminder — catalog pin requires config PR + approval and a `catalog apply` run. See docs: https://intra.redwood.dev/catalog/pinning
Tanya: I'll review the config PR. Devin, can you paste the exact pin command and the config diff you plan to push?
Devin: pushing config PR in a few: diff includes new image tag + serving profile changes (reduced max_batch to 8 for lower latency). Pin command we'll run after PR is merged: 
```
redwoodctl catalog pin --model solace-8b --version v1.2 --alias solace-stable --region us-west-2
```
Devin: deploy plan: merge PR -> run `catalog apply` in staging -> run smoke suite (Sarah) -> wait 30m -> canary pin to 5% on hosted -> monitor metrics (alerts + datadog dashboard) -> escalate if any failure -> increase to 20% -> finalize to 100% after 2h green.
Sarah: for smoke suite: I'll run the prompt regression job and a small throughput test `rb-send --qps 10 --duration 300s`. I'll post results in this thread.
Marco: rollback plan: if latency P95 > 600ms or error rate spike > 1% sustained for 5m, revert alias to v1.1 and scale down v1.2. I have the rollback commands ready.
Olivia: FYI infra note — there's a short maintenance window in us-west-2 at 23:30; we should avoid doing final 100% switch before 23:00.
Tanya: PR is up: https://git.internal/redwood/catalog/PR/4839 — reviewers: @Tanya, @Olivia. Config snippet in PR: 
```
- model: solace-8b
  version: v1.1
+ model: solace-8b
+ version: v1.2
  serving_profile:
-  max_batch: 16
+  max_batch: 8
   kv_cache: enabled
   quant: int8-lite
```
Devin: perfect. I'll wait for Tanya + Olivia approvals. Once merged, I'll call the bot to apply and ping Sarah to start smoke.
Sarah: I'll be online and will paste smoke results. If anything looks off I'll trigger rollback and ping Marco.
Marco: I'll stand by and prep the revert runbook. Also will check capacity for dedicated customers (Olivia flagged compatibility) so we don't accidentally route them.
Olivia: approved the PR + added note for dedicated customers in the release notes.
catalog-bot: apply started at 22:03 PST (staging). Job id: apply-7782.
Devin: staging apply finished, running smoke suite now.
Sarah: smoke: prompt regression 120/120 green, avg latency P50 95ms, P95 310ms, errors 0.12%. Throughput test steady at QPS 10. Looks good to me.
Devin: starting hosted canary pin to 5% at 22:28 PST.
Olivia: monitoring dashboard up — sending beats to #metrics.
Marco: watching.
Sarah: 10m in: no anomalies.
Devin: increasing to 20% at 22:58 PST per plan.
catalog-bot: pin successful for alias `solace-stable` -> v1.2 at 22:58 PST.
Tanya: recording rollout in release notes and tagging customers who requested pin.
Olivia: final check — will hold off final 100% until after the maintenance window ends at 23:45.
Devin: noted. If all green at 00:10 PST we'll finalize, else we'll keep at 20% and revisit tomorrow. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
